project.name: osgi/domains/bbox/bbox-core
project.description: The bbox domain's data + contract + logic: the flat reservation vocabulary (BboxReservationRequest / BboxRowOutcome / BboxAction), the BboxReconciler service interface (reconcile a set of desired DHCP reservations against the router, dry-run or apply), and the pure BlueprintRowEnumerator that derives the canonical RKE2 reservations from the netplan blueprint. type=model — installed as a bundle and wired bundle-to-bundle to the edge (which provides the reconciler @Component) and the scion (which resolves + drives it), both in-container. No java-bbox-api-client type crosses; no seam (the reconciler no longer crosses to the host — that was bbox-port's vestige from the host-side reconciler).
